final: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(CAST(rental_rate AS REAL) / rental_duration) AS avg_fee_per_day FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee_per_day) AS overall_avg FROM per_rating WHERE avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(p.avg_len) AS avg_running_time, AVG(p.avg_fee_per_day) AS avg_fee_to_duration, AVG(p.avg_fee_per_day - o.overall_avg) AS avg_difference FROM per_rating p JOIN overall o ON o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL WHERE p.avg_fee_per_day IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_fee_per_day > o.overall_avg
